# Introduction
```{r}
#| include: false
source("setup.R")
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
load("data/Desiccation 2025/ions.Rdata")
load("data/Desiccation 2025/volume.Rdata")
load("data/Desiccation 2025/tissue.Rdata")
load("data/Desiccation 2025/guts.Rdata")
```

# Merge data

Total of 713 crickets across all experiments. Removed control crickets.

580 crickets (non-control): 273 Females and 270 Males

```{r}
volume_data <- samples %>% select(Cricket_ID, Sex, Time, Percent_change, Total_water_content, Relative_water_loss, Mass_change_rate) %>% 
  mutate(Experiment = "Haem_vol")

ion_data <- drying_data %>% distinct(Cricket_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(Cricket_ID, Sex, Time, Percent_change, Total_water_content, Relative_water_loss, Mass_change_rate) %>% 
  mutate(Experiment = "Ions")

tissue_data <- tissue_data %>% select(Cricket_ID, Sex, Time, Percent_change, Total_water_content, Relative_water_loss, Mass_change_rate) %>% 
  mutate(Experiment = "Tissues")

gg_data <- gg_data %>% select(Cricket_ID, Sex, Time, Percent_change, Total_water_content, Relative_water_loss, Mass_change_rate) %>% 
  mutate(Experiment = "GutsGonads")


water_data <- rbind(volume_data, ion_data, tissue_data, gg_data) %>% 
  filter(Time != 0) %>% 
  mutate(Desiccation_time = ifelse(Time == 24, 18, Time),
         Cricket_ID = paste(Cricket_ID, Experiment, sep = "_"),
         WLR = Relative_water_loss / Desiccation_time)

water_data %>% 
  group_by(Sex) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(Total_water_content),
          n = n(),
          sd = sd(Total_water_content),
          se = sd/sqrt(n))
```

# Percent change in wet mass

 * No interaction between time and sex - additive model.
 * log transformed model is better fitting than the linear model
 * Variance estimate of Experiment (random effect) is close to 0 but significant on the linear model. Cannot test on the exponential model.
 * Analyse Time as continuous variable because it is log transformed.
 * Fit model on fixed effects only

```{r}
PC_mod <- water_data %>% 
  lmer(log(Percent_change) ~ log(Desiccation_time) + Sex + (1|Experiment), ., REML = FALSE) 

summary(PC_mod)

PC_mod_linear <- water_data %>% 
  lmer(Percent_change ~ Desiccation_time + Sex + (1|Experiment), ., REML = FALSE) 

AIC <- AIC(PC_mod, PC_mod_linear)
AIC[2,2]/AIC[1,2] # 5 fold difference in AIC, weights is 100%
ranova(PC_mod_linear)

PC_fit <-  tibble(Desiccation_time = rep(seq(3, 18, length.out = 10), 2),                                                                        Sex = c(rep("Female", 10), rep("Male", 10))) %>% 
  mutate(fit = exp(predict(PC_mod, newdata = ., re.form = NA)))
```

```{r}
mean_pc_loss <- water_data %>% 
  group_by(Sex, Desiccation_time) %>% 
  summarise(mean_pc = mean(Percent_change),
            se_pc = sd(Percent_change) / sqrt(n()),
            range = max(Percent_change) - min(Percent_change),
            n = n()) 

p_wetmass <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = water_data, aes(Desiccation_time, Percent_change, colour = Sex), alpha = 0.6, stroke = NA,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.height = 0, jitter.width = 0.1, dodge = 1.5)) +
  geom_point(data = mean_pc_loss, aes(Desiccation_time, mean_pc, colour = Sex), 
             size = 2, shape = 1,
             position = position_dodge(0), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = mean_pc_loss, aes(Desiccation_time, colour = Sex,
                                         ymin = mean_pc - se_pc,
                                         ymax = mean_pc + se_pc),
                width = 1, linewidth = 0.5,
                position = position_dodge(0)) +
  geom_line(data = PC_fit, aes(Desiccation_time, fit, colour = Sex), linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(y = "Wet mass lost (%)",
       x = "Desiccation time (h)") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = sex_point) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sex_pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 30), breaks = seq(0, 35, 5), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 18)) 

p_wetmass

ggsave(p_wetmass, 
       dpi = 300, width = single_width, 
       units = "mm", height = single_width, 
       filename = "data/Desiccation 2025/figures/wetmass_plot.png")
```

# Water loss

 * No interaction
 
```{r}
WL_mod <- water_data %>% 
  lmer(log(Relative_water_loss) ~ log(Desiccation_time) + Sex + (1|Experiment), ., REML = FALSE) 

summary(WL_mod)

WL_mod_linear <- water_data %>% 
  lmer(Relative_water_loss ~ Desiccation_time + Sex + (1|Experiment), ., REML = FALSE) 
anova(WL_mod, WL_mod_linear)

WL_fit <- tibble(Desiccation_time = rep(seq(3, 18, length.out = 10), 2),
                  Sex = c(rep("Female", 10), rep("Male", 10))) %>% 
  mutate(fit = exp(predict(WL_mod, newdata = ., re.form = NA)))
```


```{r}
mean_water_loss <- water_data %>% 
  group_by(Sex, Desiccation_time) %>% 
  summarise(mean_wl = mean(Relative_water_loss),
            se_pc = sd(Relative_water_loss) / sqrt(n()),
            range = max(Relative_water_loss) - min(Relative_water_loss),
            n = n()) 

p_water_loss <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = water_data, aes(Desiccation_time, Relative_water_loss, colour = Sex), alpha = 0.6, stroke = NA,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.height = 0, jitter.width = 0.1, dodge = 1.5)) +  
  geom_point(data = mean_water_loss, aes(Desiccation_time, mean_wl, colour = Sex), 
             size = 2, shape = 1,
             position = position_dodge(0), show.legend = FALSE) +  
  geom_errorbar(data = mean_water_loss, aes(Desiccation_time, colour = Sex,
                                            ymin = mean_wl - se_pc,
                                            ymax = mean_wl + se_pc),
                width = 1, linewidth = 0.5,
                position = position_dodge(0)) +
  geom_line(data = WL_fit, aes(Desiccation_time, fit, colour = Sex), linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(y = "Body water lost (%)",
       x = "Desiccation time (h)") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = sex_point) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sex_pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 40), breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.0, 0))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 18)) 

p_water_loss

ggsave(p_water_loss, 
       dpi = 300, width = 160, 
       units = "mm", height = 150, 
       filename = "data/Desiccation 2025/figures/relativeWL_plot.png")
```

# Water loss rate

* No interaction

```{r}
WLR_mod <- water_data %>% 
  lmer(log(WLR) ~ log(Desiccation_time) + Sex + (1|Experiment), ., REML = FALSE) 

summary(WLR_mod)

WLR_mod_linear <- water_data %>% 
  lmer(WLR ~ Desiccation_time + Sex + (1|Experiment), ., REML = FALSE) 
anova(WLR_mod, WLR_mod_linear)

WLR_fit <- tibble(Desiccation_time = rep(seq(3, 18, length.out = 10), 2),
                  Sex = c(rep("Female", 10), rep("Male", 10))) %>% 
  mutate(fit = exp(predict(WLR_mod, newdata = ., re.form = NA)))
```

```{r}
# Water loss rate (relative water content)
mean_WLR <- water_data %>% 
  group_by(Sex, Desiccation_time) %>%
  summarise(mean_WLR = mean(WLR),
            se_WLR = sd(WLR) / sqrt(n()),
            range = max(WLR) - min(WLR),
            n = n())

knitr::kable(mean_WLR, digits = 3)

p_WLR <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = water_data, aes(Desiccation_time, WLR, colour = Sex), alpha = 0.6, stroke = NA,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.height = 0, jitter.width = 0.1, dodge = 1.5)) +
  geom_point(data = mean_WLR, aes(Desiccation_time, mean_WLR, colour = Sex), 
             size = 2, shape = 1,
             position = position_dodge(0), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = mean_WLR, aes(Desiccation_time, colour = Sex,
                                     ymin = mean_WLR - se_WLR, 
                                     ymax = mean_WLR + se_WLR), 
                width = 1, linewidth = 0.5,
                position = position_dodge(0)) +
  geom_line(data = WLR_fit, aes(Desiccation_time, fit, colour = Sex), linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(y = expression("Water loss rate\n(% water content"%.%"h"^-1~")"),
       x = "Desiccation time (h)") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = sex_point) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sex_pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4), breaks = seq(0, 5, 0.5), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.0, 0))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(3, 6, 18)) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5), plot.margin = margin(t = 6, r = 5.5, b = 5.5, l = 20, unit = "pt"))

p_WLR

ggsave(p_WLR, 
       dpi = 300, width = single_width, 
       units = "mm", height = single_width, 
       filename = "data/Desiccation 2025/figures/WLR_plot.png")
```

# Survival 

Use ion data only because there was more mortality.

```{r}
filter(mass_data, Time != 0) %>% 
  group_by(Survival) %>% 
  summarise(n = n())

surv_mod <- glm(Survival ~ Relative_water_loss, filter(mass_data, Time != 0), family = "binomial")
surv_fit <- data.frame(Relative_water_loss = seq(0, max(mass_data$Relative_water_loss, na.rm = TRUE)), Survival = predict(surv_mod, newdata = data.frame(Relative_water_loss = seq(0, max(mass_data$Relative_water_loss, na.rm = TRUE))), type = "response"))

log(0.5/(1-0.5)) - coef(surv_mod)[1] /coef(surv_mod)[2]

ggplot(filter(mass_data, Time != 0), aes(Relative_water_loss, Survival)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(data = surv_fit, aes(Relative_water_loss, Survival)) +
  annotate(x = log(0.5/(1-0.5)) - coef(surv_mod)[1] /coef(surv_mod)[2],
           y = 0, yend = 0.5, geom = "segment", linetype = 2) +
  annotate(xend = log(0.5/(1-0.5)) - coef(surv_mod)[1] /coef(surv_mod)[2],
           x = 0, y = 0.5, geom = "segment", linetype = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 80), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(y = "Probability of survival",
       x = "Relative water loss (%)")
```

# Recovery

118 crickets: 58 females and 60 males

```{r}
all_rehydration <- bind_rows(rehydration_ions, rehydration_volume, rehydration_tissue, rehydration_guts)

all_rehydration$Cricket_ID = paste(all_rehydration$Cricket_ID, all_rehydration$Experiment, sep = "_")

rehydration_plot <- ggplot(all_rehydration, aes(Timepoint, Change, group = Cricket_ID, colour = Time_treatment, alpha = Time_treatment)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  ylab("Relative mass change (%)") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 120, 5), limits = c(70, 120), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Time point", labels = c("Pre-desiccation", "Post-desiccation", "Post-recovery")) +
  facet_grid(~Sex) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_alpha_manual(name = "Feeding state", values = c(1, 0.3), label = c("Fed", "Starved")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Feeding state", values = c("#298c8c", "#f1a226"), label = c("Fed", "Starved"))

rehydration_plot

all_rehydration %>% 
  group_by(Timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(Change),
            n = n(),
            se = sd(Change)/sqrt(n))

ggsave(rehydration_plot, 
       dpi = 300, width = double_width, 
       units = "mm", height = double_height, 
       filename = "data/Desiccation 2025/figures/rehydration.png")
```

## Recovery stats

```{r}
rm_mod <- aov(Change ~  Timepoint + Error(Cricket_ID), all_rehydration)
summary(rm_mod)
emmeans::emmeans(rm_mod,  specs = ~ Timepoint) %>%  pairs()

rm_mod <- lme4::lmer(Change ~ Timepoint + (1|Cricket_ID) + (1|Experiment), all_rehydration, REML = FALSE)
library(lmerTest)
summary(rm_mod)
anova(rm_mod)
emmeans::emmeans(rm_mod,  list(pairwise ~ Timepoint), adjust = "tukey")
```
